questiontext.text: Which of the following catastrophic consequences occurred on the day of the Battle of Aphek? (Select all that apply)

generalfeedback.text: All four events occurred on that tragic day: 30,000 soldiers died, the Ark was captured, Hophni and Phinehas died, and Eli collapsed and died (1 Samuel 4:10-18).

name.text: MID_Q18: Christian Religious Studies JSS1 Assessment

questiontext.text: Which of the following companions journeyed with Abram when he left Haran for Canaan? (Select all that apply)

generalfeedback.text: Abram journeyed with his wife Sarai, nephew Lot, and their acquired households and wealth (Genesis 12:5). Eli and Samuel lived centuries later.
